pick the address you act as

Which of your addresses this device acts as. The primary is the one your profile, the mailed code and the bearer belong to.
Which of your devices this is. It decides the WireGuard identity you receive and the device the Fleet cockpit compares against.

The token cannot read %1$s: it is expired, or lacks read access (Contents: read) to that private repository.
Getting happens here; applying happens on %1$s, item by item.

WebAuth runs GitHub CLI\'s own sign-in (gh auth login) in the gh engine, Cloud-Lib-Gh: copy the code it shows, approve it on the GitHub page that opens in cloud-browser, and the vault export is read once with the token gh then holds. Nothing is stored here.
The gh engine (%1$s) is not on this phone: install Cloud-Lib-Gh from Store ▸ Cloud Constellation ▸ Libs, then tap WebAuth again.
The gh engine (%1$s) is too old for this build: it answers contract %2$d and this page needs %3$d. Update Cloud-Lib-Gh from Store ▸ Cloud Constellation ▸ Libs.
